name: onboarding-collaboration-visibility
objective: توفير Partners field workspace وcontextual collaboration على نفس draft/assignment/document مع read visibility محكومة دون silent editing أو generic chat مكرر.
truthOwner: DSH onboarding owns collaboration context and draft permissions; existing messaging primitives are reused only if their auth/audit semantics fit.

tasks.objective: Expose field workload/drafts to authorized Partners staff and bind communication to canonical objects.
tasks.currentProblem: Without contextual workspace, operators either lack visibility or communication becomes detached/general; direct editing would destroy provenance.
tasks.requiredChange: Inventory existing message/support primitives, reuse/extend them when safe, add object-scoped threads/change requests, and build all required Partners tabs/read models without copying Workforce truth.
tasks.targetState: Authorized Partners staff can read each field actor's assigned/draft/review workload, comment on a specific draft/document, return changes, and audit every interaction; field retains controlled edit ownership by lifecycle.
tasks.action: Trace current Support/messages and Partners screens, design object binding and permissions, implement read models/tabs/messages, remove any duplicate generic communication path created solely for onboarding, and test unread/attachment/replay/isolation.
mustNotChange: لا generic chat بلا object context.
لا نسخ Workforce employment truth إلى Partners.
acceptanceCriteria: Partners field tabs تعرض workload الصحيح لكل ميداني.
return-for-changes يفتح editing للميداني فقط وفق lifecycle.
لا يوجد محرك messaging مكرر غير مبرر.
tasks.rollback: Preserve communication/audit records; disable only the new view if necessary while forward-fixing auth semantics.
tasks.commitBoundary: Contextual collaboration + Partners field workspace coherent batch.
